name: Twos
description: Add selected text to Today or another list in Twos.

options.label: API key
options.description: Create a key in Twos Settings → API Keys with write:things permission. https://www.twosapp.com/settings/api-keys

options.label: Add to list
options.description: Choose Today, or Other… and enter an existing list's exact name or list ID. Tomorrow, yesterday, and YYYY-MM-DD also work.
